title: Tiny Potato
description: A tiny potato, extracted from Botania, packaged as a resource pack.
body:
This resource pack modifies the Heavy Core model, name, and texture to the Tiny Potato one, seen in the Botania mod.

This resource pack only has the default variant.

## Credits

Vaskii owns the copyright to the texture and most of the model data.

I have fused together the two model files myself.

The Tiny Potato language files included in this resource pack are my own, adapted from Vanilla Tweaks.

The project icon is taken from the Fabric Discord server, scaled to a square image.
